quest.title: Where Is the Unseen Razor?
quest.description: Lan seems to have changed her mind about seeking the Unseen Razor.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll go for the other one. Let's make this quick.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take care of the camp on the right.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Understood. I'll go for the other one. Let's make this quick.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you already wiped out the monsters in that camp?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Just some ordinary monsters. It didn't take too much out of me. I also got lucky and found a valuable piece from a longsword.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I haven't found anything on my side...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Don't worry about it. You helped me rule out a misidentified location, so thanks.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Here, you've earned this.

choices.text: If we find all the shards...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: My desire is a simple one... I just want to reforge the Unseen Razor.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Though the blueprints detailing how the Unseen Razor was made and what materials were used have been lost... I'll find a way.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: If I can reforge the Unseen Razor, then my brother will also... *sigh*

choices.text: What will you do with them?
How's it going on your end?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Just some ordinary monsters. It didn't take too much out of me. Shame that I didn't find anything of value. It's just scrap here.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: How'd it go on your end? Did you find anything?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I found this.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Huh... That looks like a piece of a sword... Thanks. I'll bring it back with me and examine it more closely.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Thanks, Traveler. Here's your payment. Please accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Hmph, looks like it should be here.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Traveler. I didn't expect to see you here.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Do you remember the sword hilt you found last time? Well, it turns out that it was indeed part of the Unseen Razor.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: The funny thing is, the only reason I could recognize it is because I secretly etched a marking onto it as a child...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I remember I told my brother that if he ever decided to wield another sword, he had to give the Unseen Razor to me.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Heh. I suppose neither one of us could have foreseen how things turned out... I can't believe this is how I ended up finding the Unseen Razor. Looks like the sword... really did get shattered.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Alright. I suppose I'll cut to the chase now that you're here, Traveler. I'm going to need your help again.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Two gatherings of monsters should be loitering somewhere ahead. They seem to have amassed a sizable inventory of damaged weapons to hoard within their camps, though I'm uncertain as to why.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: The Adventurers' Guild is worried that these monsters will wreak havoc on the surroundings and originally wanted to draft a commission to resolve this. However, after I reviewed the details, I thought that perhaps... I could find some pieces of the Unseen Razor here.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Traveler, let's each clear out a camp.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: The camp to the left is being held by a group of hilichurls. Alone, each of them should present no danger to you...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: But their numbers are substantial. Should you face them directly and all at once, it might require some effort to prevail, even for you.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: On the right is a Stonehide Lawachurl. As for how dangerous facing one is... I don't think I really need to elaborate.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Since I'm the one who asked for your aid, I'll let you select which camp to clear.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: How goes it? You've cleared the monsters on your end?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've already... defeated all the monsters in the area?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I mean, I am the president of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild. Dealing with monsters is pretty typical for me.

dialogues.speaker: Lan

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: The situation is the same as it was previously. I'd like to invite you to head out with me and defeat some monsters.
